instructions: Lay the 2 tortillas flat on a board and spread the 1/4 cup peanut butter over them, almost to the edges.
Sprinkle the 1/2 tsp cinnamon over the peanut butter.
Peel the 2 bananas and lay one near the edge of each tortilla.
Roll each tortilla up tightly around the banana.
Slice each roll into rounds about 1 inch thick.
Serve them right away. If you're packing them, wrap each roll tightly in plastic wrap and slice it when you eat.
method_notes: Both spread peanut butter over a tortilla, add banana and roll it up. Vanderbilt Health (the lead, since neither page has a real rating count) uses an 8 inch whole wheat tortilla, 2 tbsp peanut butter, a sprinkle of cinnamon and a whole banana per roll, sliced into rounds. Veggie Fun Kitchen mashes half a banana with lemon juice, adds granola and says to wrap them tightly so the banana doesn't brown. This follows the lead but makes 2 rolls for four, so each snack is half a roll.
